Alex —

Great speaking this morning. Per our call, I’ve stitched together a compact MAP seed (v0.1) that focuses on a 45-day close sprint and a narrow evaluation scope to validate latency and cost-at-scale with your LLM inference patterns. The doc includes:

- Week-by-week milestones (tech validation, pilot dataset run, acceptance criteria)
- Stakeholder RACI (your side + Redwood owners)
- Minimal success criteria for a production pilot
- Quick risks & mitigation (networking, data access, auth/KMS)

Links/attachments: MAP-seed-v0.1.gdoc (editable) and a short 6-slide Close-Sprint-45d-slides.pptx.

Asking for:
1) Quick review of stakeholders and gaps by Tue EOD (your time)
2) Confirmation that your pilot dataset will be available by Aug 12
3) 30-min sync — propose Aug 7 at 10am PT (I added Marissa for onboarding ops)

If that timeline is tight, tell me which week you prefer and we’ll compress. I’m trying to keep acceptance gates small so we can get a meaningful performance read before commit.

Thanks,
Soojin

Soojin —

Thanks for the fast follow. I skimmed the MAP seed. Overall this looks aligned, but two asks from our side:

- Can we shift the pilot dataset cutover from Aug 12 to Aug 18? Our data extraction pipeline needs an extra week for the subset.
- The RACI lists Product as the primary approver for acceptance; can we make Ops (me) the owner of the acceptance checklist? Product wants to be consulted but not block the timeline.

I attached a short note (inline comments in the gdoc) and flagged the acceptance criteria that need to be pragmatic for our security review.

Aug 7 at 10am PT works for a quick sync — keep it on the shorter side (20–30m).

Appreciate it,
Alex
